SELECT r.id, r.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, r.book_id, b.title AS book_title, b.author AS book_author, b.isbn, r.borrow_time, r.due_time, r.return_time, r.renew_count, r.status FROM t_borrow_record r JOIN t_user u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN t_book b ON b.id = r.book_id
AND r.user_id = #{userId}
AND r.status = 0 AND r.due_time >= NOW()
AND r.status IN (0, 2) AND r.due_time < NOW()
AND r.status = #{status}
AND (b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.isbn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, r.book_id, b.title AS book_title, b.author AS book_author, b.isbn, r.borrow_time, r.due_time, r.return_time, r.renew_count, r.status FROM t_borrow_record r JOIN t_user u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN t_book b ON b.id = r.book_id WHERE r.id = #{id}
